title: Chia Pet Classic Gnome Terracotta Planter with Seed Pack
literalVisibleIdentity: One small seated orange-brown terracotta garden gnome planter with a tall pointed hat, sleepy molded face, bent legs, and a dense green chia-sprout beard growing across its chest.

features: Includes one pottery planter, a plastic drip tray, and chia seed packets for three plantings.
Full growth takes one to two weeks.
The planter can be washed and replanted indefinitely.

uncertainties: The source image shows a fully grown example beside retail packaging; generation must omit the package and preserve only the grown planter identity.
The still image cannot independently verify growth time or the number of included seed plantings, so those remain listing-confirmed facts and are not depicted as process claims.
